# Erdos.p539 — Erdős problem 539

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/539
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/539.lean`, theorem `erdos_539.variants.sq`, AMS 5 11).

Let $h(n)$ be maximal such that, for any set $A\subseteq \mathbb{N}$ of size $n$, the
set$$\left\{ \frac{a}{(a,b)}: a,b\in A\right\}$$has size at least $h(n)$.
Is $h(n) = \Theta(\sqrt{n})$?

## Statement
(fun n ↦ (cofactorThreshold n : ℝ)) =Θ[atTop] fun n ↦ √n
